summary.name: Midlibrary
summary.one_liner: Midlibrary is a searchable library of Midjourney AI art styles and SREF codes, with prompts you can copy, plus guides and compilations about Midjourney.
use_cases: Finding a Midjourney art style to match a visual look
Copying SREF codes or prompts into your own Midjourney images
Learning about Midjourney style references and versions
Browsing curated SREF code compilations by genre
Building and saving collections of favorite styles
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a library of 10,143 Midjourney styles where users can browse by look, then copy a style's prompt or SREF code to use in their own images. It also lists guides on topics such as Midjourney V6, Midjourney Remaster, and the future of reference styles. Compilations group SREF codes by theme, including dystopian, cinematic, and animation styles. Users can create collections and save styles, and the page reports 1,211 members who have made 2,842 collections.
notable: 10,143 catalogued Midjourney styles with copyable prompts and SREF codes
Covers Midjourney V6.1 through niji styles
Guides and curated SREF code compilations
caveats: Requires Midjourney to use the copied SREF codes and prompts; the page does not describe Midjourney's own pricing
Pricing for Midlibrary itself is not stated on the page
